name: Aalto Lounge Chair
description: A curved lounge chair with a steam-bent walnut frame and a supportive wool-blend cushion. Built for long evenings and good light.
dimensions: 78 x 74 x 82 cm (W x D x H)
care: Wipe frame with a dry cloth. Spot-clean cushion with mild soap and water.

name: Nordic Dining Chair
description: A light, stackable dining chair in solid ash with a gently sculpted seat.
care: Wipe with a damp cloth. Avoid direct sunlight for long periods.

name: Milo Accent Armchair
description: A boucle-upholstered armchair with a low, relaxed silhouette and brass-capped legs.
care: Vacuum regularly. Professional upholstery cleaning recommended.

name: Loop Task Chair
description: An adjustable task chair with a powder-coated steel base and breathable mesh back.
care: Wipe with a damp cloth. Check casters periodically.

name: Riva Rattan Chair
description: Hand-woven natural rattan chair with a solid wood frame, at home indoors or on a covered porch.
care: Keep dry. Dust with a soft brush.

name: Solstice Dining Table
description: A solid walnut dining table with a live-edge detail, seats six comfortably.
care: Oil the surface every 6 months. Use coasters for hot dishes.

name: Halo Coffee Table
description: Tempered smoked-glass top on a sculptural matte black steel base.
care: Clean with glass cleaner. Avoid abrasive pads.

name: Ferro Side Table
description: A slim brushed-brass side table, perfect next to a sofa or bed.
care: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth.

name: Marmo Console Table
description: A Carrara marble top on a slender brass-finished frame for entryways and hallways.
care: Seal yearly. Wipe spills immediately to avoid staining.

name: Bramble Outdoor Table
description: Weather-resistant synthetic rattan table with a tempered glass top.
care: Wipe down after rain. Cover during winter months.

name: Dune Modular Sofa
description: A deep, modular sofa in bouclé fabric with configurable chaise sections.
care: Removable covers, machine washable on cold, gentle cycle.

name: Camden Leather Sofa
description: Full-grain leather three-seater with a tailored silhouette and turned wood legs.
care: Condition leather every 6-12 months. Keep away from direct heat.

name: Pebble Loveseat
description: A compact, softly rounded loveseat suited to smaller living rooms and studios.
care: Vacuum regularly, spot clean with upholstery shampoo.

name: Nomad Sleeper Sofa
description: A pull-out sleeper sofa with a memory-foam mattress for overnight guests.
care: Removable covers, dry clean recommended.

name: Orbit Wall Mirror
description: A round wall mirror in a slim matte-black steel frame.
care: Clean with glass cleaner and a soft cloth.

name: Arch Floor Mirror
description: A full-length arched mirror with a solid oak frame, leans against any wall.
care: Wipe frame with a dry cloth. Clean glass with standard glass cleaner.

name: Sunburst Mirror
description: A brass sunburst mirror that adds a warm focal point to any wall.
care: Dust regularly. Avoid abrasive cleaners on brass rays.

name: Haven Sideboard
description: A walnut-veneer sideboard with reeded doors and brass hardware, ample storage for the dining room.
care: Wipe with a dry or barely damp cloth. Avoid direct sunlight.

name: Cube Storage Unit
description: A modular 9-cube shelving unit, great for books, bins, and display.
care: Wipe with a damp cloth.

name: Linear Bookshelf
description: An open bookshelf with slim blackened-steel frame and oak shelves.
care: Wipe frame with a dry cloth.

name: Wardrobe 2-Door
description: A two-door wardrobe in FSC-certified oak with an internal hanging rail and shelf.
care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Avoid moisture.

name: Arc Floor Lamp
description: A sweeping arc floor lamp that casts warm, ambient light over a sofa or reading chair.
dimensions: 150 cm base diameter x 200 cm height
care: Dust shade regularly. Use LED bulbs to reduce heat.

name: Pebble Table Lamp
description: A soft, organic-shaped table lamp in frosted glass with a linen shade.
care: Dust with a dry cloth.

name: Rattan Pendant Light
description: A hand-woven rattan pendant that diffuses light into warm, dappled patterns.
care: Dust with a soft brush. Keep dry.

name: Terra Vase Set
description: A set of three stoneware vases in warm, earthy tones.
care: Hand wash only.

name: Wool Throw Blanket
description: A chunky-knit wool throw, soft enough for daily use on a sofa or bed.
care: Dry clean or gentle hand wash, lay flat to dry.

name: Woven Wall Hanging
description: A handwoven cotton and jute wall hanging with fringed detail.
care: Spot clean only. Keep out of direct sunlight.
